instructions: Use build and run for this worktree's Xcode project instead of calling xcodebuild or xcrun simctl yourself; `simctl ... booted` can reach another worktree's simulator.
Call build or run only when the user asks for it, not to check your own edits.

tools.name: build
tools.label: Build
tools.description: Builds this worktree's Xcode project like Chord's Cmd-B, in the worktree's own DerivedData; the user sees the log in Chord. Answers 'Build succeeded', 'Stopped' when the user started another build, or 'Build failed' with the error lines.
tools.promptSnippet: Build this worktree's Xcode project and get its errors

tools.name: run
tools.label: Run
tools.description: Builds the app and runs it on this worktree's own simulator like Chord's Cmd-R; the user sees the log and the app in Chord. Answers 'Launched', 'Stopped' when the user started another build, or 'Build failed' with the error lines.
tools.promptSnippet: Build the app and launch it on this worktree's simulator
